record.label: Bell-basis parity for spin swaps
record.statement: After a Clifford change to the Bell basis, each block of controlled spin swaps is a controlled sign flip on states with an odd number of antisymmetric Bell pairs. The circuit computes the parity once for two swap blocks.
record.boundary: The Lean theorem establishes equivalence for the composed circuit. Appendix I.3 derives the factor of two by computing the parity once for each pair of swap blocks.
